name: SUB-2: ⚙️ Server Setup (Docker + n8n + PostgreSQL + Authelia + SSL)

nodes.name: Wait 60s for SSH
nodes.notes: Wait for server to fully boot and SSH to become available

parameters.command:
=#!/bin/bash
set -e

SERVER_IP="{{ $json.server.ip }}"
ROOT_PASSWORD="{{ $json.server.root_password }}"
CUSTOMER_ID="{{ $json.customer_id }}"
DOMAIN="{{ $json.domain }}"
CUSTOMER_EMAIL="{{ $json.owner.email }}"
CUSTOMER_NAME="{{ $json.owner.name }}"

cat > /tmp/setup_${CUSTOMER_ID}.sh << 'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "===== PHASE 1: System Update ====="
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y
apt-get upgrade -y

echo "===== PHASE 2: Install Docker ====="
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
systemctl enable docker
systemctl start docker

echo "===== PHASE 3: Install PostgreSQL ====="
apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib
systemctl enable postgresql
systemctl start postgresql

# Secure PostgreSQL
sudo -u postgres psql -c "ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD '$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 32)';"

echo "===== PHASE 4: Install n8n ====="
mkdir -p /app/n8n
cat > /app/n8n/docker-compose.yml << 'N8N_COMPOSE'
version: '3'
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: n8n
    restart: always
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=${DOMAIN}
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=https
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - WEBHOOK_URL=https://${DOMAIN}
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=UTC
      - N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
    network_mode: host

volumes:
  n8n_data:
N8N_COMPOSE

cd /app/n8n && docker compose up -d

echo "===== PHASE 5: Install Authelia ====="
mkdir -p /app/authelia
AUTHELIA_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 64)
AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 64)

cat > /app/authelia/configuration.yml << AUTHELIA_CONFIG
server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 9091

log:
  level: debug

jwt_secret: ${AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET}

default_redirection_url: https://${DOMAIN}

authentication_backend:
  file:
    path: /config/users_database.yml
    password:
      algorithm: argon2id

access_control:
  default_policy: deny
  rules:
    - domain: "${DOMAIN}"
      policy: one_factor

session:
  name: authelia_session
  secret: ${AUTHELIA_SECRET}
  expiration: 3600
  inactivity: 300
  domain: ${DOMAIN}

storage:
  local:
    path: /config/db.sqlite3

notifier:
  filesystem:
    filename: /config/notification.txt
AUTHELIA_CONFIG

# Generate admin password
ADMIN_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -base64 16 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 16)
CUSTOMER_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -base64 16 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 16)

cat > /app/authelia/users_database.yml << USERS_DB
users:
  admin:
    displayname: "Admin"
    password: "$(docker run --rm authelia/authelia authelia crypto hash generate argon2 --password ${ADMIN_PASSWORD} | grep 'Digest:' | cut -d' ' -f2)"
    email: admin@prismity.ai
    groups:
      - admins
  customer:
    displayname: "${CUSTOMER_NAME}"
    password: "$(docker run --rm authelia/authelia authelia crypto hash generate argon2 --password ${CUSTOMER_PASSWORD} | grep 'Digest:' | cut -d' ' -f2)"
    email: ${CUSTOMER_EMAIL}
    groups:
      - users
USERS_DB

cat > /app/authelia/docker-compose.yml << 'AUTHELIA_COMPOSE'
version: '3'
services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    container_name: authelia
    restart: always
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./configuration.yml:/config/configuration.yml:ro
      - ./users_database.yml:/config/users_database.yml:ro
      - authelia_data:/config
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC

volumes:
  authelia_data:
AUTHELIA_COMPOSE

cd /app/authelia && docker compose up -d

echo "===== PHASE 6: Install Nginx ====="
apt-get install -y nginx

cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/prismity << 'NGINX_CONFIG'
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name ${DOMAIN};
    return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name ${DOMAIN};

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/${DOMAIN}/privkey.pem;

    # n8n
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:5678;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    # Authelia
    location /authelia {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:9091;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
}
NGINX_CONFIG

ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/prismity /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default

echo "===== Setup Complete ====="
echo "Admin Password: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}"
echo "Customer Password: ${CUSTOMER_PASSWORD}"

REMOTE_SCRIPT

# Execute on remote server
sshpass -p "${ROOT_PASSWORD}" scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /tmp/setup_${CUSTOMER_ID}.sh root@${SERVER_IP}:/tmp/
sshpass -p "${ROOT_PASSWORD}" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@${SERVER_IP} "chmod +x /tmp/setup_${CUSTOMER_ID}.sh && /tmp/setup_${CUSTOMER_ID}.sh"

nodes.name: 🔧 Execute Server Setup
nodes.notes: Install Docker, PostgreSQL, n8n, Authelia, configure nginx

parameters.command:
=#!/bin/bash
set -e

SERVER_IP="{{ $('Extract Credentials').first().json.server_ip }}"
ROOT_PASSWORD="{{ $('When called by Master').first().json.server.root_password }}"
DOMAIN="{{ $('Extract Credentials').first().json.domain }}"

sshpass -p "${ROOT_PASSWORD}" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@${SERVER_IP} << REMOTE_SSL
apt-get install -y certbot
cd /app
docker compose stop nginx || true
certbot certonly --standalone \
  -d ${DOMAIN} \
  --non-interactive \
  --agree-tos \
  --email admin@prismity.ai

systemctl restart nginx
echo "SSL_CONFIGURED: success"
REMOTE_SSL
